TUN.note: Nothing on rules or authority against AI harms.
The app serves a water utility, a sector system.

facts.fact: The agriculture ministry presented Aqua Min 360, an app by the state water-transfer company SECADENORD, built with a national AI model, that analyses pumping station data and recommends pumping hours and pump settings.

TUN.note: A national AI model is mentioned without a name, builder or release.
